project.title: Microbiota of early life home dust samples in the Wayne County Health Environment Allergy and Asthma Longitudinal Study (WHEALS) birth cohort
project.description: Stored early life house dust samples in the WHEALS birth cohort were used to examine factors associated with house dust community composition, and explore how this impacts child health later in life.
